name: Mukhyamantri Konya Atmonirbhor Yojana
benefit: Each eligible student will receive a free Scooty. This Scooty is intended to be useful for them to travel to their College.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Tripura. 1. The applicant should be a girl. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The parents/guardians of the applicant should be natives of Tripura or have a continuous residence in Tripura for not less than 10 years. 1. The applicant should be studying in the 1st semester of a course at the General Degree College in Tripura.
